summary: Full backend + frontend test pass for A2Z Plant Nutrient site. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests pass (health, seed idempotency, careers, blogs CRUD + search/category, media CRUD, contact). Frontend: home, projects (6/6), blog list + detail + add-blog publish flow, add-media flow, gallery, admin (blog+media tabs, delete with confirmation), contact form submission with toast, careers page all functional. Fixed missing data-testid forwarding in Motion.Stagger wrapper.
critical_code_review_comments: Motion.jsx Stagger/StaggerItem components dropped extra props (fixed data-testid forwarding on Stagger). Consider forwarding rest props on FadeIn/StaggerItem/ScaleIn/FloatingLeaf for consistency and future testability.
server.py slugify strips underscores after non-alnum removal but doesn't insert a separator (e.g. 'TEST_Blog' → 'testblog') — minor cosmetic quirk, not blocking.
Backend has no authentication for admin CMS endpoints (/add-blog, /add-media, DELETE) — documented as intended per problem statement but worth flagging as production risk.
test_credentials: N/A - admin pages are public (no auth)
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seed on startup created 3 blogs, 4 careers, 10 media. Verified idempotent via POST /api/seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py can be reused for regression. Frontend uses NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Testids on projects-grid, blog-list, careers-list depend on Motion.jsx Stagger component forwarding rest props — do not revert that fix. Project slugs: nhai-avenue-plantation, ntpc-township-landscape, nfl-industrial-greening, bhel-campus-landscape, vda-public-park, hindustan-copper-plantation (not 'greenscape' variants).
